03 / HOW THESIMPLE WORKS

A senior product unit that stays with the problem.

We do not disappear after strategy, hand design to someone else, or treat launch as the finish line. The same core team carries context from the first difficult question through evidence, experience, build and learning.

OUR OPERATING MODEL

One team keeps the context alive.

Our advantage is continuity. Strategy knows what research found. Design understands the business constraint. Engineering sees the interaction intent. Everyone is solving the same product problem—not their own department’s version of it.

01 / FRAME TOGETHER

Start with the difficult truth.

We challenge the brief, define the real problem, align success and decide what must be true before more work begins.

02 / PROVE EARLY

Turn assumptions into evidence.

Research, prototypes and technical spikes are used where they can actually change a decision—not as documentation theatre.

03 / BUILD AS ONE

Experience and engineering move together.

Design intent, edge cases, reusable foundations and implementation choices evolve in the same room.

04 / STAY FOR LEARNING

Launch creates the next signal.

We observe behaviour, friction and adoption, then turn that evidence into the next focused product move.

Yes. We can operate as a focused senior product unit, lead a transformation, strengthen an internal team, or own a clearly defined product stream from framing through production.

HOW THESIMPLE WORKSFULL OWNERSHIP

One team.
Full ownership.

From the first brief to the final deliverable, the people shaping the strategy stay connected to the work. Founder Akhileswar Reddy Ajjaguttu is part of every engagement — not only the pitch — working with the team through framing, product direction, critical reviews, trade-offs, delivery and launch quality.

01Brief → truth

We interrogate the brief, business model, constraints, audience and success criteria before committing to output.

02Direction → decisions

Founder + team align strategy, product, brand, experience and technical direction so there is one intent from day one.

03Craft → build

Research, design, prototyping and engineering stay connected. We solve the product while we make it.

04Quality → delivery

We own the complete deliverable: details, edge cases, accessibility, implementation fidelity, performance and hand-off quality.

05Launch → learn

Launch is part of the work. We stay close to feedback, adoption, iteration and the next critical product decision.

WHY THIS OPERATING MODEL

High context beats long chains of hand-offs.

We deliberately keep the core working group close to the problem and senior enough to decide. That gives clients continuity from the first conversation to the final deliverable without adding layers whose main job is relaying information.

When a project needs a specialised capability, we add the right expertise around the core instead of building hierarchy around it. The result is a team that can stay personal, move quickly and still take on serious, multi-disciplinary work.

Founder-connected

Akhileswar remains part of framing, key product decisions, critical reviews and final quality — from brief through delivery.

Maker access

You can speak to the people doing the thinking and making the work, not only an account layer.

One context

Business, brand, product, design and engineering decisions are made against the same objective.

Flexible depth

We expand specialist capability when the problem requires it, without losing the accountable core.

WHAT WE CAN OWN

One team.
Every layer.

We can enter at the idea, the brand, the product, the technology or the launch — then connect the missing pieces around it. The point is not to sell disciplines separately. It is to keep the outcome coherent from first decision to final delivery.

Brand + identity

Positioning, naming, visual language, campaigns and the system that makes the brand recognisable everywhere.

Product strategy

Opportunity framing, proposition, prioritisation, roadmap and the decisions that make the product worth building.

Research + discovery

User, market and behavioural research translated into useful product evidence — not research theatre.

Product design

UX, UI, interaction, prototyping, service flows and design systems across complex digital experiences.

Physical + service

Connected physical experiences, kiosks, service moments and journeys where screens are only one part of the system.

Product management

Scope, requirements, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment and delivery rhythm that keep teams moving on the same outcome.

Engineering + AI

Frontend, backend, integrations, AI-enabled workflows and production-ready implementation connected to the design intent.

Launch + growth

GTM support, instrumentation, optimisation and post-launch learning so shipping is the beginning of the feedback loop.

What clients actually get

Full ownership from the brief to every committed deliverable. Direct access to the people making consequential decisions, fewer translation layers, faster resolution of ambiguity, and one accountable path from idea to shipped outcome.
